title: Binder composition for positive electrode, and secondary battery
abstract: The present invention provides that the paste stability of the composition for positive electrodes prepared using the binder composition, the peeling strength of the positive electrode composite layer formed using the composition for positive electrodes, and the secondary performance of the positive electrode using the positive electrode having the positive electrode composite layer can be well maintained A binder composition for non-aqueous secondary battery positive electrodes, a non-aqueous secondary battery positive electrode composition, a non-aqueous secondary battery positive electrode positive electrode, and a non-aqueous secondary battery that balance the output characteristics of the battery. The binder composition for non-aqueous secondary battery positive electrodes of the present invention includes a polymer and an organic solvent, the polymer includes a conjugated diene monomer unit and/or an alkylene structural unit and a nitrile group-containing monomer unit, the above The solution turbidity of the binder composition for non-aqueous secondary battery positive electrodes is 1 or more and 80 or less.
